title: Molecular Dynamics Reveals Structural Consequences of Schizophrenia-Associated SLC6A1 Variants.
authors: Abashkin, Dmitrii A; Abdurazakov, Amal; Marilovtseva, Ekaterina V; Semina, Ekaterina V; Chaika, Yulia A; Golimbet, Vera E
one_liner_zh: 该文用微秒级分子动力学模拟解析精神分裂症相关SLC6A1/GAT-1转运蛋白错义突变引起的局部结构重排，属于蛋白质结构计算研究，但对象为膜转运蛋白而非典型可溶性蛋白，且方法为常规MD应用，创新性有限。
abstract: The SLC6A1 gene encodes the GAT-1 transporter, which mediates the reuptake of GABA in the central nervous system (CNS). Missense variants in this gene are associated with the development of neuropsychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia. Although in vitro assays demonstrate a loss of transport activity, they do not elucidate how specific amino acid substitutions disrupt local interactions within the protein. To delineate the structural consequences of these mutations, we analyzed the inward-open apo-state of human GAT-1 (PDB: 7Y7V) using microsecond-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. This study compares the wild-type transporter with mutant forms, including the schizophrenia-associated variants R211C and A305T, alongside the A346S variant selected via deep learning-based pathogenicity predictors. The results demonstrate that these mutations do not globally destabilize the protein structure; rather, they induce specific rearrangements within local contact networks. The R211C substitution abolishes a hydrogen bond at the interface of extracellular loop 2 (EL2) and transmembrane helix 4 (TM4). A305T alters the TM1-TM6 interface adjacent to the sodium ion-binding site, and A346S strengthens TM1/TM6-EL4 interactions. The identified structural shifts suggest how pathogenic mutations remodel the GAT-1 interaction network and alter its conformational dynamics. These findings provide a foundation for subsequent molecular docking aimed at drug repurposing and for comprehensive MD modeling of the complete GAT-1 transport cycle.
abstract_zh: SLC6A1基因编码GAT-1转运体，其介导中枢神经系统（CNS）中GABA的再摄取。该基因的错义变异与神经精神疾病（包括精神分裂症）的发生相关。尽管体外实验表明转运活性丧失，但并未阐明特定氨基酸替换如何破坏蛋白质内部的局部相互作用。为描绘这些突变的结构后果，我们利用微秒级分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟分析了人GAT-1的内向开放脱辅基状态（PDB: 7Y7V）。本研究比较了野生型转运体与突变形式，包括精神分裂症相关变异R211C和A305T，以及通过基于深度学习的致病性预测器选出的A346S变异。结果表明，这些突变并未全局性地破坏蛋白质结构；相反，它们诱导了局部接触网络内的特定重排。R211C替换消除了细胞外环2（EL2）与跨膜螺旋4（TM4）界面处的氢键。A305T改变了邻近钠离子结合位点的TM1-TM6界面，而A346S增强了TM1/TM6-EL4相互作用。所识别的结构变化提示致病突变如何重塑GAT-1相互作用网络并改变其构象动力学。这些发现为后续旨在药物重定位的分子对接以及GAT-1完整转运循环的综合MD建模奠定了基础。
